21384-afar-in-the-forest.title: Afar In The Forest
21384-afar-in-the-forest.creator: Unknown
21384-afar-in-the-forest.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. s I returned one evening from a hunting excursion--it having been my duty that day to go out in search of game for our larder. Uncle Mark had just come in from his day's work, which had been that of felling the tall trees surrounding our habitation. He and I together had cleared an acre and a half since we came to our new location.

75922-the-amazing-adventures-of-letitia-.title: The Amazing Adventures Of Letitia Carberry
75922-the-amazing-adventures-of-letitia-.creator: Unknown
75922-the-amazing-adventures-of-letitia-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. (Miss Lewis was Tish’s nurse, a splendid woman, but a heavy sleeper. She slept on a cot in the room, and until Tish learned that it did not hurt the clock to throw it, she had been obliged to ring for one of the night nurses to come in and waken her. So now she threw the clock.)

arxiv-1806-03595.title: CONSTRUCTIONS OF k k -g-FUSION FRAMES AND THEIR DUALS IN HILBERT SPACES
arxiv-1806-03595.creator: Vahid Sadri, Reza Ahmadi, Asghar Rahimi
arxiv-1806-03595.description: Abstract . Frames for operators or k k -frames were recently considered by G a ˘ \breve{\mbox{a}} vruta (2012) in connection with atomic systems. Also generalized frames are important frames in the Hilbert space of bounded linear operators. Fusion frames, which are a special case of generalized frames have various applications.

arxiv-2102-01423.title: Vision Based Autonomous UAV Plane Estimation And Following for Building Inspection
arxiv-2102-01423.creator: Yang Lyu, Muqing Cao, Shenghai Yuan, and Lihua Xie
arxiv-2102-01423.description: Abstract Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) has already demonstrated its potential in many civilian applications, and the façade inspection is among the most promising ones. In this paper, we focus on enabling the autonomous perception and control of a small UAV for a façade inspection task.

arxiv-2103-12484.title: The Onset of Chaos in Permanently Deformed Binaries from Spin-Orbit and Spin-Spin Coupling Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2103-12484.creator: Darryl Seligman, Konstantin Batygin
arxiv-2103-12484.description: Abstract Permanently deformed objects in binary systems can experience complex rotation evolution, arising from the extensively studied effect of spin-orbit coupling as well as more nuanced dynamics arising from spin-spin interactions. The ability of an object to sustain an aspheroidal shape largely determines whether or not it will exhibit non-trivial rotational behavior.

arxiv-2304-01290.title: A Simple Approach for General Task-Oriented Picking using Placing constraints
arxiv-2304-01290.creator: Jen-Wei Wang, Lingfeng Sun Xinghao Zhu, Qiyang Qian, Masayoshi Tomizuka
arxiv-2304-01290.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jen-Wei Wang, Lingfeng Sun Xinghao Zhu, Qiyang Qian, Masayoshi Tomizuka. Pick-and-place is an important manipulation task in domestic or manufacturing applications. There exist many works focusing on grasp detection with high picking success rate but lacking consideration of downstream manipulation tasks (e.g., placing). Although some research works proposed methods to incorporate task conditions into grasp selection, most of them are data-driven and are therefore hard to adapt to arbitrary operating environments.

arxiv-2306-12339.title: Non-linear and negative effective diffusivity of optical excitations in moiré-free heterobilayers
arxiv-2306-12339.creator: Edith Wietek, Matthias Florian, Jonas M. Göser, Takashi Taniguchi, Kenji Watanabe, Alexander Högele, Mikhail M. Glazov, Alexander Steinhoff, Alexey Chernikov
arxiv-2306-12339.description: Abstract Interlayer exciton diffusion is studied in atomically-reconstructed MoSe 2 /WSe 2 heterobilayers with suppressed disorder. Local atomic registry is confirmed by characteristic optical absorption, circularly-polarized photoluminescence, and g -factor measurements. Using transient microscopy we observe propagation properties of interlayer excitons that are independent from trapping at moiré- or disorder-induced local potentials.

arxiv-2404-16895.title: QuERLoc : Towards Next-Generation Localization with Quantum-Enhanced Ranging Conference: ;
arxiv-2404-16895.creator: Entong He, Yuxiang Yang, Chenshu Wu
arxiv-2404-16895.description: Abstract . Remarkable advances have been achieved in localization techniques in past decades, rendering it one of the most important technologies indispensable to our daily lives. In this paper, we investigate a novel localization approach for future computing by presenting QuERLoc , the first study on localization using quantum-enhanced ranging.

arxiv-2503-08847.title: Can we determine the exact size of the nucleon?: A comprehensive study of different radii
arxiv-2503-08847.creator: The MMGPDs Collaboration: Muhammad Goharipour 1,2, Fatemeh Irani 3, M. H. Amiri 3, H. Fatehi 3, Behnam Falahi 3, A. Moradi 3, K. Azizi 3,4,2
arxiv-2503-08847.description: Abstract The concept of nucleon radii plays a central role in our understanding of the internal structure of protons and neutrons, providing critical insights into the non-perturbative regime of quantum chromodynamics (QCD). While the charge radius is often interpreted as the “size” of the nucleon, this interpretation is an oversimplification that overlooks the multifaceted nature of nucleon structure.

arxiv-2504-19792.title: Contextures: The Mechanism of Representation Learning
arxiv-2504-19792.creator: Runtian Zhai
arxiv-2504-19792.description: Abstract This dissertation establishes the contexture theory to mathematically characterize the mechanism of representation learning, also known as pretraining. Despite the remarkable empirical success of foundation models, it is not very clear what representations they learn, and why these representations are useful for various disparate downstream tasks.

arxiv-2510-21099.title: Tessellations of rational complex functions and the Riemann’s existence theorem
arxiv-2510-21099.creator: Alvaro Alvarez–Parrilla, Roberto Gutiérrez–Soto, Jesús Muciño–Raymundo
arxiv-2510-21099.description: Abstract A complex rational function R R , of degree n ≥ 2 n\geq 2 , on a compact Riemann surface M M provided with a cyclic order on its q q distinct critical values, determines an homogeneous tessellation of the Riemann surface M M , whose 2 ​ n 2n tiles are topological q q –gons with alternating colors.

arxiv-2602-08557.title: Constrained Sampling to Guide Universal Manipulation RL
arxiv-2602-08557.creator: Marc Toussaint 1,2 , Cornelius V. Braun 1 , Eckart Cobo-Briesewitz 1 , Sayantan Auddy 1 , Armand Jordana 3 , Justin Carpentier 4
arxiv-2602-08557.description: Abstract We consider how model-based solvers can be leveraged to guide training of a universal policy to control from any feasible start state to any feasible goal in a contact-rich manipulation setting. While Reinforcement Learning (RL) has demonstrated its strength in such settings, it may struggle to sufficiently explore and discover complex manipulation strategies, especially in sparse-reward settings.

arxiv-2603-11107.title: From Computational Certification to Exact Coordinates: Heilbronn’s Triangle Problem on the Unit Square Using Mixed-Integer Optimization
arxiv-2603-11107.creator: Nathan Sudermann-Merx

plos-pone-0001925.creator: Mathias Gehrmann, Gerhard Liebisch, Gerd Schmitz et al.
plos-pone-0001925.description: PLOS ONE research article. Human tumors differ from normal tissues in their capacity to present Hsp70, the major stress-inducible member of the HSP70 family, on their plasma membrane. Membrane Hsp70 has been found to serve as a prognostic indicator of overall patient survival in leukemia, lower rectal and

pmc-10531778.title: Impaired Nitric Oxide Synthetase Activity in Primary Ciliary Dyskinesia—Data-Driven Hypothesis
pmc-10531778.creator: Lisa Eggenkemper, Anne Schlegtendal, Christoph Maier, Thomas Lücke, Folke Brinkmann, Bibiana Beckmann, Dimitrios Tsikas, Cordula Koerner-Rettberg, Adam Kimple
pmc-10531778.description: Low nasal nitric oxide (nNO) is a typical feature of Primary Ciliary Dyskinesia (PCD). nNO is part of the PCD diagnostic algorithm due to its discriminative power against other lung diseases, such as cystic fibrosis (CF). However, the underlying pathomechanisms are elusive.

pmc-10567841.title: Bioremediation of n-alkanes, polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons, and heavy metals from wastewater using seaweeds
pmc-10567841.creator: Faiza M. A. Akl, Suzan I. Ahmed, Mostafa M. El-Sheekh, Mofida E. M. Makhlof
pmc-10567841.description: The removal of n-alkanes, polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons, and heavy metals from wastewater using three dried seaweeds Ulva intestinalis Linnaeus (green alga), Sargassum latifolium (Turner) C.Agardh (brown alga), and Corallina officinalis Kützing (red alga) has been shown to evaluate their potential usage as inexpensive adsorbents.

pmc-10574311.title: Cannabidiol-Loaded Lipid-Stabilized Nanoparticles Alleviate Psoriasis Severity in Mice: A New Approach for Improved Topical Drug Delivery
pmc-10574311.creator: Mark Zamansky, Doron Yariv, Valeria Feinshtein, Shimon Ben-Shabat, Amnon C Sintov, Sudeshna Chandra, Heinrich Lang
pmc-10574311.description: Cannabidiol (CBD) is a promising natural agent for treating psoriasis. CBD activity is attributed to inhibition of NF-kB, IL-1β, IL-6, and IL-17A. The present study evaluated the anti-psoriatic effect of cannabidiol in lipid-stabilized nanoparticles (LSNs) using an imiquimod (IMQ)-induced psoriasis model in mice.

pmc-10636257.title: Effect of Selenium on Lung Injury Induced by Limb Ischemic Reperfusion Injury in Sprague-Dawley Rats
pmc-10636257.creator: Dudy Arman Hanafy, Christha Zenithy Tamburian, Lisnawati Rachmadi, Gerald Aldian Wijaya, Widya Trianita Suwatri, Sugisman
pmc-10636257.description: PurposeIschemia-reperfusion injury (IRI) plays an important role in the pathophysiology of acute limb ischemia, leading to damage to distant organs, including the lungs. A complex mechanism is involved in the formation of reactive oxygen species (ROS), release of inflammatory mediators, and neutrophil activation.

pmc-10748394.title: Single-cell RNA sequencing analysis of lung cells in COVID-19 patients with diabetes, hypertension, and comorbid diabetes-hypertension
pmc-10748394.creator: Xin Zhang, Xiaoqian Deng, Liangliang Zhang, Pengbo Wang, Xia Tong, Yan Mo, Yuansheng Zhang, Yan Zhang, Chunheng Mo, Lanlan Zhang
pmc-10748394.description: BackgroundThere is growing evidence that the lung is a target organ for injury in diabetes and hypertension. There are no studies on the status of the lungs, especially cellular subpopulations, and related functions in patients with diabetes, hypertension, and hypertension-diabetes after combined SARS-CoV-2 infection.

pmc-11511261.title: Non-Structural Carbohydrates Accumulation in Seedlings Improved Flowering Quality of Tree Peony under Forcing Culture Conditions, with Roots Playing a Crucial Role
pmc-11511261.creator: Shuaiying Shi, Tian Shi, Shuang Zhou, Shuangcheng Gao, Yuan Zhao, Guoan Shi, Gianluca Caruso
pmc-11511261.description: (1) Tree peony (Paeonia suffruticosa Andrews) is a woody ornamental plant originating from China, and beloved by people worldwide. Non-structural carbohydrates (NSCs) play a crucial role in regulating the flowering quality of tree peonies in both field and potted conditions.

pmc-12401138.title: Wnt Signalling‐Activated EN2 Promotes the Progression of Glioblastoma by Upregulating Fatty Acid Synthesis Metabolism
pmc-12401138.creator: Junjun Zhang, Shengjun Zhou, Zifeng Dai, Fanyong Gong, Jianfei Zhang
pmc-12401138.description: Glioblastoma (GBM) is the most aggressive primary brain tumour, with limited treatment options and a propensity for rapid development of resistance to therapies. Previous studies have indicated that fatty acid metabolic reprogramming is a critical marker of tumour progression and plays a significant role in the proliferation and migration of cancer cells.

pmc-12454059.title: Wedelia trilobata-derived biochar mitigates chromium toxicity and improves physiological performance in hydroponically grown Chinese cabbage
pmc-12454059.creator: Fengyue Qin, Weidong Li, Menglu Dong, Shuangqi Yue, Guojie Weng, Mingxuan Wang, Xinyu Shan, Waqas Ahmed, Jiechang Weng, Sajid Mehmood
pmc-12454059.description: IntroductionEnsuring future agricultural sustainability requires innovative solutions to alleviate abiotic stress caused by heavy metal(loid) contamination. Chromium (Cr) toxicity is a major abiotic stressor that threatens leafy vegetable productivity and food safety.MethodsThis study investigates the potential of Wedelia trilobata-derived biochar (WBC= 0, 0.1, 0.

pmc-12654620.title: In Situ Raman Measurement of the Growth of SiCOH Thin Film Using Hexamethyl-Disiloxane (HMDSO) Mixture Source in Semiconductor Interconnection
pmc-12654620.creator: Hwa Rim Lee, Tae Min Choi, Sung Gyu Pyo
pmc-12654620.description: This research focuses on the real-time monitoring of SiCOH thin films grown by chemical vapor deposition (CVD) using Raman spectroscopy. To ensure the reliability of CVD-deposited materials in semiconductor processes, the study analyzes the growth and properties of thin films in situ.

pmc-12666801.title: Chronic sternal pain relief after a pecto-intercostal fascial plane block: A case report
pmc-12666801.creator: Harlyn Naika Veloso-Evans, Kyle Wentz, Neville Campbell
pmc-12666801.description: BackgroundChronic sternal pain is relatively common in adults and particularly in patients after surgery involving the chest wall such as with cardiac surgery or mastectomy. Treatment options for patients with chronic sternal pain have largely consisted of physical therapy and oral medications.

pmc-12997039.title: Morphological and molecular characterization of Halamphora lukasiewiczii sp. nov. (Bacillariophyceae, Amphipleuraceae), a new extremophilic diatom from petroleum seeps in the Polish Carpathians
pmc-12997039.creator: Mateusz Rybak, Łukasz Peszek, Ewa Górecka, Renata Zadrąg-Tęcza, Zlatko Levkov
pmc-12997039.description: Crude oil is toxic in high concentrations. However, several microalgae are able to proliferate in these extreme environments. In this study, we describe diatoms in natural oil seeps in the Polish Carpathians. Only two species were found: Halamphora lukasiewicziisp. nov. and Navicula salinarum.

pmc-13050612.title: Persistent Hyperglycaemia and Transient Dysglycaemia in Tuberculosis: Evaluating the Bidirectional Interaction With Type‐2 Diabetes Mellitus and Clinical Outcomes
pmc-13050612.creator: Augustine Asare Boadu, Prince Asare, Michelle Yeboah‐Manu, Stephen Osei‐Wusu, Emelia Danso Konadu, Adwoa Asante‐Poku, Yayra Klinogo, Abraham Adjei, Desmond Omane Acheampong, Jane S. Afriyie‐Mensah, Dorothy Yeboah‐Manu, Yacoba Atiase
pmc-13050612.description: IntroductionPoor glycaemic control, indicated by a haemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) level of 7% or higher, increases the risk of active tuberculosis (TB) in patients with diabetes, while active TB can worsen glucose tolerance and insulin resistance, contributing to type‐2 diabetes mellitus (DM) progression.

pmc-13236122.title: Cannabis Expectancies as a Mediator in the Relationship Between Cannabis Use and Psychiatric Symptoms in Women With Post-traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD) Symptoms
pmc-13236122.creator: Karina Villalba, Jennifer Attonito, Amie Newins
pmc-13236122.description: ObjectiveThis study examined whether cannabis expectancies mediate the relationship between lifetime cannabis use and symptoms of anxiety or depression among women who screened positive for post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD).MethodA total of 271 women completed an online survey assessing PTSD symptoms, lifetime cannabis use, anxiety and depression symptoms, and cannabis expectancies.

pmc-13244268.title: TRAP1 ablation improves mitochondrial cristae and oxidative phosphorylation in pancreatic cancer stem cells
pmc-13244268.creator: Giulia Ambrosini, Elisa Dalla Pozza, Ilaria Cristanini, Sara Vinco, Enrica Cappellozza, Barbara Cisterna, Claudio Laquatra, Andrea Rasola, Emanuela Bottani, Ilaria Dando
pmc-13244268.description: Aim: Cancer stem cells (CSCs) in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) display high metabolic plasticity, supporting tumor aggressiveness and therapeutic resistance. Here, we investigated the role of the mitochondrial chaperone TRAP1 in regulating mitochondrial architecture, metabolism, and adhesion in CSCs. Methods: We studied an in vitro model of CSCs using Panc1 cells and the corresponding stable TRAP1-knockout cells (TRAP1-KO).

pmc-13349835.title: Knowledge gaps, psychological burden, and patient-reported symptom severity and daily functioning in autoimmune gastritis: a observational survey of Chinese patients
pmc-13349835.creator: Miaoyan Chen, Shurong Hu

pmc-13572695.title: The application effect of mobile internet technology in the postoperative follow-up management of patients with lumbar intervertebral disc protrusion
pmc-13572695.creator: Yan Ruan, Danlei Zheng, Weiwei Chu, Jie Yu
pmc-13572695.description: ObjectiveTo explore the application effect of mobile Internet technology in the postoperative follow-up management of patients with lumbar intervertebral disc protrusion.Methods100 patients with lumbar disc herniation undergoing percutaneous lumbar discectomy were randomly divided into two groups. The control group (50 cases) received routine follow-up management, and the intervention group (50 cases) received follow-up management based on mobile Internet technology.

pmc-13573403.title: Development and internal validation of a nomogram for predicting prolonged ICU length of stay after oral free flap reconstruction without prophylactic tracheostomy
pmc-13573403.creator: Longwen Zhang, Yaping Song, Hongsheng Ji
pmc-13573403.description: ObjectiveTo develop and validate a nomogram for predicting prolonged ICU length of stay (LOS) in patients undergoing oral free flap reconstruction without prophylactic tracheostomy.MethodsThis single-center retrospective study included 419 consecutive patients treated between January 2019 and July 2025. Patients were randomly assigned to a training set (n = 294) and a validation set (n = 125) at a 7:3 ratio.

pmc-13576732.title: Triangular Versus Circular Implant Neck Design and Their Effect on Marginal Bone Loss: a Systematic Review
pmc-13576732.creator: Daniel Simonov, Yossef Haim Avramov, Lior Bangiev, Yasmin Ayala Izraelov, Jaunius Juodžbalys
pmc-13576732.description: ObjectivesThis literature review evaluates the differences between triangular and circular neck designs and their influences on marginal bone remodelling as well as peri-implant hard and soft tissue health. The primary aim was to compare implant survival and hard-tissue outcomes (peri-implant bone level, implant stability quotient and insertion torque).
